    '(* Reduce only the finite array structure, keeping the cell predicates opaque. *)\n' +
    'Ltac finite_array_pred fuel P :=\n' +
    '  lazymatch fuel with\n' +
    '  | O => constr:(P)\n' +
    "  | S ?fuel' =>\n" +
    '    lazymatch P with\n' +
    '    | (?a # Char |-> ?v) => constr:(P)\n' +
    '    | (?a # Char |->_) => constr:(P)\n' +
    '    | emp => constr:(P)\n' +
    '    | TT => constr:(P)\n' +
    '    | “ ?p ” => constr:(P)\n' +
    '    | ?A ** ?B =>\n' +
    "        let A' := finite_array_pred fuel' A in\n" +
    "        let B' := finite_array_pred fuel' B in\n" +

    "    | _ => let P' := eval red in P in finite_array_pred fuel' P'\n" +
    '    end\n' +
    '  end.\n' +
    '\n' +
    '(* Build the finite spatial witnesses without changing either cell heap. *)\n' +
    'Ltac finite_leaf :=\n' +
    '  first [ assumption | reflexivity |\n' +

    '\n' +
    'Ltac finite_heap :=\n' +

    '  [ exact Hheap\n' +

    '  | let u := fresh "u" in let U := fresh "U" in let JU := fresh "JU" in\n' +
    '    destruct (unit_join h) as [u [U JU]];\n' +

    '\n' +
    'Ltac finite_array_entail :=\n' +
    '  lazymatch goal with\n' +
    '  | |- ?P |-- ?Q =>\n' +

    "      let P' := finite_array_pred fuel P in\n" +

    "      change (P' |-- Q'); cbn [repeat_Z]; entailer!;\n" +
    '      try finite_heap\n' +
    '  end.\n' +
    '\n' +
    'Theorem resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_1_split_goal_spatial : ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_1_split_goal_spatial.\n' +

    '  right; exact resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_2_split_goal_spatial.\n' +
    'Qed.\n' +
    'Theorem resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_1 : ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_1.\n' +
    'Proof.\n' +
    '  unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_1.\n' +
    '  cbn [repeat_Z]; entailer!.\n' +
    'Qed.\n' +
    'Theorem resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_spatial : ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_spatial.\n' +
    'Proof.\n' +
    '  unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_spatial.\n' +
    '  finite_array_entail.\n' +
    'Qed.\n' +
    'Theorem resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_3 : ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_3.\n' +
    'Proof.\n' +
    '  unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_3.\n' +
    '  right.\n' +
    '  finite_array_entail.\n' +
    'Qed.\n' +
    'Theorem resolved_init_array2_return_wit_1 : ExecutionGoal.init_array2_return_wit_1.\n' +
    'Proof.\n' +
    '  unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_return_wit_1.\n' +
    '  right; intros n_pre p_pre H1 H2 H3 Hp Hn H6 H7.\n' +
    '  subst p_pre; subst n_pre.\n' +
    '  intros h Hh; exists (0 :: 0 :: nil).\n' +
    '  revert h Hh.\n' +
    '  change (\n' +
    '    (((4096 + ((0 + 1) * sizeof(CHAR)))) # Char |-> 0)\n' +
    '    ** (((4096 + (0 * sizeof(CHAR)))) # Char |-> 0)\n' +
    '    |-- CharArray.full 4096 2 (0 :: 0 :: nil)).\n' +
    '  finite_array_entail.\n' +
    'Qed.\n' +
    'Print Assumptions resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_1_split_goal_spatial.\n' +
    'Print Assumptions resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_1.\n' +
    'Print Assumptions resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_2_split_goal_spatial.\n' +
    'Print Assumptions resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_2.\n' +
    'Print Assumptions resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_1.\n' +
    'Print Assumptions resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_spatial.\n' +
    'Print Assumptions resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_3.\n' +
    'Print Assumptions resolved_init_array2_return_wit_1.\n',

    'Theorem resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_1_split_goal_spatial : ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_1_split_goal_spatial.\n' +
    'Proof.\n' +
    '  unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_1_split_goal_spatial.\n' +
    '  unfold CharArray.full, store_array, repeat_Z.\n' +
    '  simpl store_array_rec.\n' +
    '  unfold StoreCharAsElement.storeA.\n' +
    '  cbn [Z.add Z.mul].\n' +
    '  unfold derivable1, sepcon, andp, coq_prop, emp.\n' +
    '  intros m [hi [lo [J [Hhi Hlo]]]].\n' +
    '  destruct (unit_join hi) as [u [Hu Ju]].\n' +
    '  exists lo, hi. split.\n' +
    '  - apply join_comm. exact J.\n' +
    '  - split; [exact Hlo |].\n' +
    '    exists hi, u. split; [exact Ju |].\n' +
    '    split; [exact Hhi |].\n' +
    '    repeat first [exact Hu | reflexivity | split | lia].\n' +
    'Qed.\n' +
    'Theorem resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_1 : ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_1.\n' +
    'Proof.\n' +
    '  unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_1.\n' +
    '  right. exact resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_1_split_goal_spatial.\n' +
    'Qed.\n' +
    'Theorem resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_2_split_goal_spatial : ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_2_split_goal_spatial.\n' +
    'Proof.\n' +
    '  unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_2_split_goal_spatial.\n' +
    '  unfold CharArray.full, store_array, repeat_Z.\n' +
    '  simpl store_array_rec.\n' +
    '  unfold StoreCharAsElement.storeA.\n' +
    '  cbn [Z.add Z.mul].\n' +
    '  unfold derivable1, sepcon, andp, coq_prop, emp.\n' +
    '  intros m Hm.\n' +
    '  destruct (unit_join m) as [u [Hu Ju]].\n' +
    '  exists m, u. split; [exact Ju |].\n' +
    '  split; [exact Hm |].\n' +
    '  repeat first [exact Hu | reflexivity | split | lia].\n' +
    'Qed.\n' +
    'Theorem resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_2 : ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_2.\n' +
    'Proof.\n' +
    '  unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_2.\n' +
    '  right. exact resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_2_split_goal_spatial.\n' +
    'Qed.\n' +
    'Theorem resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_1 : ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_1.\n' +
    'Proof.\n' +
    '  unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_1.\n' +
    '  unfold derivable1, coq_prop, repeat_Z. intros. reflexivity.\n' +
    'Qed.\n' +
    'Theorem resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_spatial : ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_spatial.\n' +
    'Proof.\n' +
    '  unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_spatial.\n' +
    '  unfold CharArray.undef_full, store_undef_array.\n' +
    '  simpl store_undef_array_rec.\n' +
    '  unfold StoreCharAsElement.undefstoreA.\n' +
    '  cbn [Z.add Z.mul].\n' +
    '  unfold derivable1, sepcon, andp, coq_prop, emp.\n' +
    '  intros m [hi [lo [J [Hhi Hlo]]]].\n' +
    '  destruct (unit_join hi) as [u [Hu Ju]].\n' +
    '  exists lo, hi. split.\n' +
    '  - apply join_comm. exact J.\n' +
    '  - split; [exact Hlo |].\n' +
    '    exists hi, u. split; [exact Ju |].\n' +
    '    split; [exact Hhi |].\n' +
    '    repeat first [exact Hu | reflexivity | split | lia].\n' +
    'Qed.\n' +
    'Theorem resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_3 : ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_3.\n' +
    'Proof.\n' +
    '  unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_3.\n' +
    '  right. unfold derivable1, andp.\n' +
    '  intros m Hm. split.\n' +
    '  - exact (resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_1 m Hm).\n' +
    '  - exact (resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_spatial m Hm).\n' +
    'Qed.\n' +
    'Theorem resolved_init_array2_return_wit_1 : ExecutionGoal.init_array2_return_wit_1.\n' +
    'Proof.\n' +
    '  unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_return_wit_1.\n' +
    '  right. intros n p H1 H2 H3 Hp Hn H6 H7.\n' +
    '  subst p. subst n.\n' +
    '  change (\n' +
    '    (((4096 + (1 * 1))) # Char |-> 0) ** ((4096) # Char |-> 0)\n' +
    '    |-- EX (l2 : list Z), CharArray.full 4096 2 l2).\n' +
    '  unfold derivable1, exp. intros m Hm.\n' +
    '  exists (repeat_Z 0 2).\n' +
    '  exact (resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_1_split_goal_spatial m Hm).\n' +
    'Qed.\n' +
    'Print Assumptions resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_1_split_goal_spatial.\n' +

    'Print Assumptions resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_2_split_goal_spatial.\n' +
    'Print Assumptions resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_2.\n' +
    'Print Assumptions resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_1.\n' +
    'Print Assumptions resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_spatial.\n' +
    'Print Assumptions resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_3.\n' +
    'Print Assumptions resolved_init_array2_return_wit_1.\n'
